proof_explanation: With the corrected implementation where negate(value) returns Bool.not(value), the equality negate(value) == Bool.not(value) is satisfied by reflexivity, since both sides of the equation are syntactically identical.

seeded_attack.reason: Any implementation deviating from negate(value) = Bool.not(value) violates the negate_matches_boolean_not law, which mandates total Boolean negation. The seeded attack must be rejected for failing to enforce this legal requirement.
